SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date
FROM dim_campaign
WHERE LOWER(campaign_name) LIKE '%black week%' OR LOWER(campaign_name) LIKE '%2025%'
ORDER BY start_date DESC

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 15 AS campaign_id
),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout h
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, members, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) AS mean_net_sales_per_member
FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'uplift (targeted - holdout)', NULL,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END)
           - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2)
FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'check: members in both groups', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted JOIN holdout USING (member_id)), NULL;

WITH campaign_window AS (
    SELECT start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign
    WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout
    WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
web_dispatch_dates AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
targeted_sales AS (
    SELECT t.member_id, COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS total_sales
    FROM targeted_members t
    LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.member_key IN (
        SELECT member_key FROM dim_member WHERE member_id = t.member_id
    )
    LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch_dates w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign_window
    WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
       OR (s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
           AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign_window.start_date AND campaign_window.window_end)
    GROUP BY t.member_id
),
holdout_sales AS (
    SELECT h.member_id, COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) AS total_sales
    FROM holdout_members h
    LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = h.member_id
    LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.member_key = m.member_key
    LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch_dates w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign_window
    WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
       OR (s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
           AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign_window.start_date AND campaign_window.window_end)
    GROUP BY h.member_id
),
results AS (
    SELECT 
        'Targeted members' AS metric,
        ROUND(AVG(total_sales), 2) AS value
    FROM targeted_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'Held-out members' AS metric,
        ROUND(AVG(total_sales), 2) AS value
    FROM holdout_sales
)
SELECT metric, value FROM results
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Uplift (euros)' AS metric,
    ROUND((SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM targeted_sales) - (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM holdout_sales), 2) AS value
